Commentary.Commentary: Right! The first game is done and dusted in 190 minutes. No time wasting. England have also wasted no time in adjusting to the conditions and have won convincingly, without this being their best squad. New Zealand do not have much time for a turnaround as the second T20I starts on Sunday, 3rd November, 2019 at 2 pm local (0100 GMT). Join us then. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious England captain, Eoin Morgan, hits the nail on the head. Says that the game was more or less won or lost in the first innings itself, as he feels that they were chasing a total 20 below par on a surface which was two-paced. Praises his bowlers and specially the debutants, for holding their nerves. Is enjoying England's welcome to New Zealand's shores. On fielding three debutants, Morgan says that the management needs time to get a settled 15 into the World Cup in October and the resting of 7 guys is a plan in that direction. Admits that all new players will not get a chance to go to Australia but believes that at least the selectors get some options. Is happy to be 1-0 up and is looking forward to the next match in Wellington.

New Zealand's captain, Tim Southee, admits that it is a tough start for the series. Praises England but feels that New Zealand were off in all three departments. Adds that a couple of early wickets could have put pressure on the England batters but it never happened. With the bat, he reckons that they could have got a few runs more.

JAMES VINCE HAS BEEN AWARDED THE MAN OF THE MATCH (Sigh... batsman's game). Praises his bowlers for setting up the win, as the total was not a huge one to chase. On the pitch, feels that it was a good one to bat upon, especially after getting set. Lauds captain Morgan for taking his side home.

A difficult match for the Kiwi bowlers. Their batsmen could not quite get a big total and they simply could not find anything on the surface to keep England quiet. And this is a side without Jason Roy, Jos Buttler, Ben Stokes, Alex Hales and Joe Root. D. E. P. T. H. Who is your Man Of The Match? Chris Jordan? Or James Vince? Please stayed tuned for the presentation...

A very important match for James Vince. He has this habit to getting in, feeling good, making the team look nice and then throw it away. He did that again in this game, getting to 59 and making the cardinal sin of not staying till the end. But because the job was not that difficult, he got away with it.

A comfortable win for England in the end. They never looked to be in trouble and it was a matter of one good partnership and one set batsman staying deep. The first two stands set the tone and then the 54-run stand between Vince and Morgan sealed the deal.

SIX! ENGLAND WIN BY 7 WICKETS! What a batting effort from the English team. Southee goes short and on middle, Morgan pulls it handsomely. The ball sails up and over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. The fielder there is a mere spectator.
FOUR! Morgan stays back to this length ball and flat-bats it past the bowler. Santner at mid off dives across to  his left. But fails to field it. The ball in the end reaches long off for a boundary.
Southee goes short and wide outside off, Morgan looks to cut but fails to middle it as the ball goes past the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Tim Southee comes back on.
Short and outside off, cut through point for one more.
On middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
FOUR! That is lucky. A length ball, outside off, Billings swings hard and gets a thick inside edge past the stumps towards fine leg!
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Down the leg side, Morgan looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the keeper. A run taken and no signal from the umpire. Did that hit the glove? Yes, he signals.
FOUR! Good start to the over. Full and outside off, Morgan gets underneath it and lofts it over mid off. 17 more needed from as many balls.
Lockie Ferguson to bowl out. 3-0-17-0 so far.
Morgan punches this flatter one through covers for a single.
Billings dances down the track to this tossed up ball and lofts it to  long on for a single.

Sodhi goes short and Billings pulls it superbly in the gap between long on and mid-wicket. The fielder from long on runs to his right and saves a couple of runs for his team. The batsmen take a couple.

FOUR! Billings this time attempts a reverse sweep and gets a boundary. Sodhi goes full and down leg, Billings is quick to switch over and places the ball in the gap between point and third man. The ball races to the fence for a boundary at third man.
Morgan flicks this tossed up ball on his pads to mid-wicket for a single.
Billings pushes this flatter one through the off side for a single.
Ish Sodhi is back on.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run. 2 runs and a wicket from the over. 4-0-23-3 for Santner, an excellent job.
Around off, well defended.
Comes down the track and Santner fires it outside leg. Sam looks to flick but gets a leading edge, which does not carry to short extra cover.
Billings watchfully defends this tossed up ball to the off side.
Sam Billings walks in at number 5, replacing Vince.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket and the man to take is Guptill. Santner goes short and Vince pulls it through mid-wicket. But as he failed to get under the ball, he is unable to get the timing and the distance. Martin stationed there in the deep this time takes the easiest of the grabs. Vince throws away another start.
Tossed up on off, Morgan pushes it to point for a single.
Santner is back on. 3-0-21-3 so far.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. One run added to the total.
Excellent yorker, around middle, dug out back to the bowler.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Terrific shot. Full and around off, Vince comes down the track and flicks it all the way over square leg, with his right leg in the air. Flamingo!
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Superb shot. Just fractionally short of a length and not too wide outside off. But captain Morgan backs away and punches it behind point.
Tim Southee is back on. 2-0-7-0 so far.
Vince plays the defensive shot on this length ball outside off.
Once again Morgan backs away to push this length ball outside off through covers for a single.

FOUR! Morgan shows his batting skill there. Ferguson goes short and outside off, Morgan rocks back crouches a bit and upper cuts it over the vacant slip cordon. The ball goes to the third man fence for a boundary.
Brilliant batting this from Vince. He just pushes it to mid off for a single.

FOUR! MAIDEN T20I FIFTY FOR VINCE! Brilliant timing on that. Ferguson bowls it wide outside off, Vince punches it through point off the back foot for a boundary. He has done the hard work. Now, for staying till the end.
Slower one and full outside off, Vince lets it through.
Lockie Ferguson returns. 2-0-7-0 so far.
Works this through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Cracking shot. A short ball, outside off, Vince pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
SIX! Fine shot. A length ball, around off, Vince lofts this straight back over long on!
Gets across his stumps, looks to flick but misses. Kuggeleijn appeals for LBW but the impact was outside off.
Vince gets to the pitch of this tossed up ball and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. This time Sodhi goes short and Vince just cuts it through point. The ball races away to the fence in a flash.
FOUR! Pleasing to the eye stuff. Sodhi bowls a fuller one outside off, Vince gets on the front foot and drives it superbly through the covers for a boundary.

Another brillant fielding effort from Guptill in the deep. Sodhi tosses one up outside off, Morgan goes for the reverse sweep and places it in between cover and point. But Guptill in the deep does well to run across to his left to field. Only a single results.
Tossed up outside off, Vice cuts it through point.
Leg break on off, Vince drives it to covers.
Change of ends for Ish Sodhi. 2-0-17-0 so far.
A good length ball outside off, Morgan throws his bat at it but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
A long hop, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for one.
Full and wide outside off, Morgan reaches out, aiming to steer it to third man but misses.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Scott Kuggeleijn returns. 1-0-15-0 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. Excellent over from Santner.
Skipper Eoin Morgan walks in at number 4, replacing Bairstow.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant stuff in the field from Martin Guptill! What a catch in the deep by the Kiwi stalwart there. Santner goes flatter and wide outside off, Bairstow has to go and fetch his pull from wide outside off. But Jonny fails to get it from the middle of the bat. Finally he could manage a drag pull which goes to deep mid-wicket where Martin Guptill takes a good tumbling grab. So Bairstow departs and England lose their second one.
Tossed up on the pads, Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Vince drives it through covers for one.
Tossed up on the pads, Bairstow flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one on off, Vince pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A short ball, outside leg, Bairstow pulls it behind square leg and the ball races away! 10 from the over.

Works this wide of mid on for a single. Santner comes running in and fires a rocket throw to Sodhi who is unable to collect. Tim Southee backing up at cover dives to his left to stop both - the ball and the batsmen from taking the second.
Comes down the track and works it straight to the bowler.
FOUR! Half chance. Full and around off, Vince hammers it straight back. Sodhi takes evasive action, looking to duck, then going for the catch on the second attempt but misses. The ball races away.
How did that miss the stumps? The slider from Sodhi, around middle, Vince goes back to punch but the ball skids through and just misses the stumps!
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, Vince looks to sweep but misses.
Around off, punched towards mid on. Santner himself runs to his right to stop.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Around middle and off, worked through square leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and around middle, Vince comes down the track and works it towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Vince rocks back and punches it through the covers!
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Ish Sodhi is rewarded for that catch as he is asked to go into the boiling cauldron.
Outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a run. 42/1 IN THE POWERPLAY, as compared to New Zealand's 39/2.
FOUR! Nice way to get going. Short and outside off, Vince rocks back and cuts it through point. The fielder dives to his left but in vain.
James Vince walks in at number 3, replacing Malan.

OUT! Caught! The first wicket falls at last. Full and around middle and leg, Malan comes down the track, looks to go downtown but is not to the pitch of the ball. The ball lands, spins away, takes the leading edge and goes to short third man where Ish Sodhi takes it calmly. The entertaining opening stand is broken.
Full and around off, swept through square leg for a single.
Outside off, driven straight to cover.
FOUR! GORGEOUS! Full and outside off, Bairstow leans and drives it through the covers!
Mitchell Santner into the attack.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED, FOUR! A short ball, around middle, Malan pulls it straight to square leg. Martin Guptill leaps, sticks out his right hand but cannot quite take it. The ball is parried to the mid-wicket fence. Tough chance.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
A yorker on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
Tim Southee comes back on. 1-0-1-0 so far.
Outside off, Bairstow looks to cut but misses. Gets a bottom edge which goes to the off side.
Full and outside off, JB drives it straight to mid off.
A slower ball, wide outside off, comes back in, Jonny looks to slash, has to reach out but misses.
Full and down the leg side, Malan sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! A short ball outside off, Malan pulls it wide of mid on and gets a boundary!
FOUR! This time on the other side. Short and outside off, Bairstow cuts it through point and the ball races away! 18 from the over and England are up and running.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Bairstow pulls it over mid-wicket!
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
SIX! BELLIGERENT! A length ball outside off, Bairstow picks it up and swings it over square leg!
Full and around middle, pushed uppishly towards mid on.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack! Full and around off, Bairstow looks to drive hard but the ball swings in, takes the inner half of the bat and runs wide of mid on!
Scott Kuggeleign comes in straightaway.
Around middle and leg, Malan plays that from the crease, back to the bowler. Superb from Southee in the opener, well backed up by Lockie here.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
That stays low, skidding off a length, missing the bat and hitting the pads as the batsman misses his flick. An LBW appeal ensues but that was pitching outside leg.
Almost a replica of the first ball of this over. Only this time, Bairstow is the batsman. A single taken to deep point with a slash.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Short and wide outside off, slapped over point, but there is a fielder in the deep. A single taken.
Lockie Ferguson to bowl from the other end.
Full delivery on off, Bairstow drives it to mid off. Just 1 run of the first over.
Bowls it down the leg side, Bairstow looks to go after it but misses it.

What was the noise? Looks like something has come off Bairstow's willow. In fact, it is a piece of wood. Short of a length delivery on off, Bairstow looks to pull but the ball hits the bottom half of the bat and goes towards short mid-wicket. Jonny immediately has a look at his bat and checks it. The piece has gone to the off side. Lucky that it has not hit the stumps.
Full delivery on off, Bairstow looks to drive but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the leg side.
Good length delivery on middle, Bairstow looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length on middle, Bairstow drives it to mid on.
Starts with a full delivery outside off, Bairstow drives it to covers.
We are back for the chase. Jonny Bairstow and Dawid Malan will open the batting for England. Tim Southee will start the proceedings for New Zealand.
